policy: A public family changes from pending only through a reviewed acceptance decision with cited contract, implementation, source/declaration, browser, documentation, consumer, and limitation evidence. Matching names, source paths, generated SVG resources, or a successful command never accept a family. An accepted record additionally retains a completed verification review identifier.

families.reviewedDecision: The public Icon browser contract is accepted against the fixed upstream API with explicit Vue slot/ref/ARIA and environment differences. Source and declaration checks, pure Vapor and separate interop browser behavior, documentation examples, package provenance, and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed; the cited contract and evidence were independently reviewed. Acceptance of other public families is recorded independently.

limitations: 直接 SVG 资源包装不声明 span 包装或 spin 行为。
Icon 使用 svg/default slot；作用域提供 size: 1em、只读 fill 和实例 id。动态字段通过 scope 对象读取，调用方显式绑定 SVG 定义和引用。
不克隆 VNode；ref 仅公开 getElement()；elementType 为 Icon。颜色通过 currentColor 继承，多色资源保留原色。
浏览器 ESM 提供真实 Icon；UI 根的 Node import 条件仅提供已有静态工具及对应声明，不导出 Icon。icons 包根与组件子路径需浏览器 Vapor 运行时。无 CJS、组件 SSR 或 hydration 支持。
Vue RC9 与 vue-jsx RC2 精确锁定；vue-jsx 的 ^3 peer 严格安装限制仍存在。独立预编译应用消费者不代表独立 TSX 编译器安装问题已解决。
浏览器行为限 Chromium；截图不表示完整像素级一致性。

mappings.api: Icon span 包装、六种 size、spin、整数 rotate、prefixCls/type/class/style/native attrs 已映射；React svg 节点改为 svg/default slot，fill 由调用方显式读取，ref 改为 getElement()，convertIcon 接收同一 SVG slot 工厂。ARIA 默认装饰性，有名称时为 img；显式 role/aria-hidden 优先。
mappings.types: IconProps 映射为 Vue HTMLAttributes、只读 fill、IconSlots 和 IconHandle；另提供 IconSize、IconSvgScope、ConvertedIconProps。源/声明正反类型与实际 tarball 消费验证，不宣称 React 类型同构。
mappings.statics: Icon 与 convertIcon 结果提供 elementType = Icon，无静态子组件。固定上游的动态赋值 marker 不在 AST 静态成员索引中，人工契约和浏览器/类型测试覆盖。
mappings.subpaths: 浏览器 semi-icons-vue 根及 ./Icon 提供 default/Icon/convertIcon；semi-ui-vue 根提供具名 Icon，./icons 另提供 default。Node import 的 UI 根仅静态工具且声明一致。固定上游 icons 使用 legacy main/module/types，无 exports map，故不虚构结构化子路径映射；不提供 CJS、SSR 或 hydration。

families.reviewedDecision: The public ConfigProvider and ConfigConsumer browser contracts are accepted against the fixed upstream API with explicit native Vapor slot, own-key inheritance, stable DOM wrapper and responsive lifecycle differences. Source and generated declaration checks, browser and documentation behavior, pure Vapor and separate interop tarball consumers, and resource cleanup passed independent review. Locale data is forwarded through the existing context; public locale components remain outside this acceptance.

limitations: 稳定 div/dir 与按 own key 嵌套继承是明确的 Vue 差异；undefined 清空、缺失继承。
Consumer 使用原生 Vapor scoped slot 传递只读 Ref，不是 React Consumer children 机制；公开 LocaleProvider/LocaleConsumer 由独立 locale 族验收。
响应式首次同步采样、按需监听，map/启用会通知，卸载函数失效；禁用保留最近快照。
locale/timeZone只传递现有配置，不提供 locale fallback 或日期转换；host保留创建realm边界。
仅浏览器ESM，Node根不导出组件；不支持组件SSR/水合/CJS。Vue RC peer/exact调用点/Chromium和截图限制不变。

mappings.api: 六props与静态默认断点图、两个订阅重载保留；嵌套继承、稳定wrapper、启用和map刷新通知及失效保护为Vue差异。
mappings.types: ConfigProviderProps/ConfigContextValue、Readonly Ref scoped slot与响应式类型明确映射，不暴露React类型。
mappings.statics: ConfigProvider.defaultResponsiveMap 与子路径命名defaultResponsiveMap同一只读对象；无静态子组件。
mappings.subpaths: 浏览器UI根提供ConfigProvider/ConfigConsumer/useConfigContext；./configProvider提供default与命名组件、defaultResponsiveMap及类型。Node根保留静态设施。固定上游legacy子路径无exports map，不虚构结构化子路径。

families.reviewedDecision: The public LocaleProvider and LocaleConsumer browser contracts are accepted against the fixed upstream language selection and field fallback behavior. Native Vapor scoped slots, explicit dictionary-key generics, independent locale/config contexts and their differences are documented. Strict source and generated declarations, dynamic and isolated browser behavior, live documentation, all 57 generated dictionaries and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed verification and independent implementation review. Other public families remain independently assessed.

limitations: Native scoped slots carry a stable readonly Ref instead of four positional React callback arguments. Explicit string-key generics provide dictionary types; unparameterized Consumer dictionaries are unknown.
Public inputs remain complete Locale objects. Coded partial runtime dictionaries are not merged; missing code resets the whole locale, undefined dateFnsLocale falls back, currency does not.
Only actual ConfigProvider locale participates in precedence over LocaleProvider; independent G09 defaults do not mask it. Existing ConfigProvider inheritance and explicit clearing remain unchanged.
timeZone is configuration data; dateFnsLocale is formatting language data. No date picker, automatic timezone conversion or asynchronous loader is provided.
Browser ESM and ordinary Vue interop are separate paths. Node UI roots exclude the components; locale/source/* and interface remain static entries. No CJS, component SSR or hydration.
Pinned RC9/RC2, strict declarations, separate exact-optional call-site checks and the compiler peer-install limitation remain. Chromium screenshots are not complete pixel parity.

mappings.api: Provider replaces its dictionary and defaults omitted/undefined locale to zh_CN. Consumer selects Config locale then independent Locale locale, validates code and preserves field/dateFns/currency fallback differences. No wrapper DOM, events or exposed methods.
mappings.types: Generated Locale is unchanged. Consumer string-key generic, unknown/undefined boundaries and VaporRenderResult slots replace unconstrained React T and positional children callbacks.
mappings.statics: No static child components or public instance methods; defaultProps become synchronous defaults.
mappings.subpaths: Browser root exports both components, hook and types; ./locale aggregates default Provider and named Consumer. Legacy deep component-file paths are not exported. Existing ./locale/source/* and ./locale/interface retain static Node access.

families.reviewedDecision: The public Spin browser contract is accepted against the fixed upstream defaults, derived loading state, DOM and styles. Native Vapor slot and attribute differences, instance-scoped delay cancellation, global-default edge cases, source/generated declarations, live documentation, Chromium behavior and four isolated tarball consumers passed complete local verification and independent review. Other public families remain independently assessed.

limitations: React children/indicator/tip nodes become native Vapor slots. Block layout follows default-slot presence; slots are not invoked to inspect their content. No VNode cloning or React callback equivalence is claimed.

Initial true plus truthy delay remains visible. Later delays use one scoped timer with cancellation and stale-task rejection; this fixes the upstream render-time timer race. Global defaults are captured per instance; call-site undefined and global own undefined have distinct verified behavior.

Global Spin configuration includes only size, spinning, delay, tip, wrapperClassName, childStyle and style. Custom indicator/children/tip nodes belong to slots; the upstream global clone path is not provided.

The default SVG has instance-isolated gradient IDs. Callers manage semantics and IDs inside custom indicators. The mask does not disable keyboard interaction or provide focus management, automatic live/busy/status or spoken tip updates.
Fixed upstream Spin CSS has no built-in reduced-motion branch. Application CSS must handle that preference. Light/dark, RTL and narrow Chromium checks do not establish complete pixel parity.

Browser ESM root and spin subpath are separate from the static Node root. Pure Vapor and ordinary Vue interop are verified separately; no component SSR, hydration or CJS is provided. RC9/RC2 remain pinned; strict JSX compiler peer installation and all-dependency exact-optional compatibility are not claimed.

mappings.api: 三尺寸、spinning/delay、文本tip、wrapperClassName/childStyle和遮罩保留来源语义；React节点改原生default/indicator/tip slots。初次truthy delay仍可立即显示；后续取消、延迟重配和过期回调由既有scope管理。default slot存在决定block。根仅转发声明的class/style、role/ARIA/data；无事件、model或公开实例方法。
mappings.types: SpinProps/SpinSize映射固定来源；VaporRenderResult slots、StyleValue与有限DOM属性替代ReactNode/CSSProperties。SpinSlots是新增Vue类型。正反例覆盖原始文本/null/Promise slot与不支持属性边界。
mappings.statics: 保留只读Spin.__SemiComponentName__ = Spin；无静态子组件。getDerivedStateFromProps是React生命周期，不作为公开静态API导出；默认值通过实例配置解析与Vue响应式状态实现。
mappings.subpaths: 浏览器根具名Spin/types；semi-ui-vue/spin提供default/named Spin与types。Node根仅静态设施。上游./lib/es/spin、./lib/es/spin/icon、./lib/es/spin/icon.js、./lib/es/spin/index和./lib/es/spin/index.js未作为兼容路径公开；内部icon与状态机不导出。无CJS、组件SSR或水合。

families.reviewedDecision: Accepted the fixed upstream IconButton browser contract implemented with native Vapor slots and a private BaseButton. Strict source/generated declarations, native events and forms, lifecycle and animation cleanup, themed documentation, per-file coverage, and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed local verification and independent source review. Explicit API and environment differences remain documented; this does not deliver public Button or group components.

limitations: 原生 icon/default slots 与 text 标量替代 React 节点；colorful 通过只读 fill scope 显式绑定，不克隆 VNode。空 slot 仍保留文本容器；动态条件使用原生 v-if，顶层数组/JSX三元混合不列为已验证用法。
保留固定上游 iconSize/iconStyle no-op、原始 theme/type 分支及 prefixCls 只影响装饰类的行为。BaseButton 私有且不注册全局默认；公开 Button 和组合按钮由 button 族独立验收。
loading CSS仅阻断指针，不禁键盘或程序click；disabled为原生禁用且优先保留普通图标。回调为Vue命名的原生事件，不提供React合成事件或新增回调别名。
复用现有SpinIcon和CSS动画，不创建JS计时器。全局Spin.indicator ReactNode路径沿用不支持边界；无自定义loading indicator slot。
公开浏览器根与./iconButton支持原生Vapor；普通Vue interop单独验收。Node根只静态工具，无组件SSR/水合/CJS承诺。
固定Vue RC9/vue-jsx RC2/Semi2.103.0；skipLibCheck=false严格声明和额外exact调用点检查分离，vue-jsx ^3 peer严格安装RC限制仍存在。截图仅局部布局证据，浏览器仅指定Chromium。

mappings.api: 原生 button/content 结构、图标位置、padding、尺寸/theme/type/block/circle/colorful、loading与disabled优先级、原生表单和事件；children以text/default slot映射，icon以readonly fill作用域slot映射。保留iconSize/iconStyle no-op和分层默认值及prefix限制。
mappings.types: IconButtonProps继承Vue原生button属性并区分视觉type/htmlType；IconButtonSlots、IconButtonIconScope和HorizontalPaddingType支持原生Vapor块、只读fill与明确undefined。BaseButton内部声明依赖不是公开出口。
mappings.statics: 仅保留elementType = IconButton；无静态子组件、公开实例方法或全局defaults入口。
mappings.subpaths: 浏览器根具名IconButton与./iconButton默认/具名同一实现；CSS/SCSS为styles/components/iconButton。固定上游lib/es及lib/cjs旧路径不提供；Node根排除组件和私有BaseButton/Button组。

families.reviewedDecision: The native Vapor Button, ButtonGroup and SplitButtonGroup browser contracts are accepted against the fixed upstream source with explicit DOM child registration, slot forwarding and nested split ownership differences. Source and generated declarations, pure Vapor and separate Vue interop behavior, lifecycle cleanup, live Chinese documentation, themed styles and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed verification and independent review. BaseButton remains a private runtime leaf, and acceptance does not extend to other public families.

limitations: Public components are browser-native Vapor ESM; the Node root exposes static infrastructure only. Component SSR, hydration and CJS are not supported. Vue 3.6.0-rc.9 and vue-jsx 3.3.0-rc.2 remain locked; the compiler ^3 peer rejects strict independent RC installs, and precompiled consumers do not resolve that limitation.

Button uses scalar text and native default/icon slots in place of React nodes. Icon slot presence selects the route without executing the slot. Decorative SVG attributes and colorful fill are supplied by the caller. iconSize/iconStyle retain upstream no-op behavior.

Global Button defaults are captured per instance before child and group resolution. Own undefined falls back to a captured global own key, otherwise it blocks disabled/size/type group inheritance before Base defaults. Group own theme/colorful override the child, with undefined falling back to the captured global value.

ButtonGroup coordinates only registered public Button roots that are direct DOM children, settling after the mount/update flush. A wrapper DOM node prevents inheritance; a custom component returning a direct Button root participates. Standalone IconButton, native buttons and other components are not cloned or injected. Nested groups own their registered children.

Group separator boundaries use rendered element/nonempty text siblings, ignoring Vapor anchors and empty branches instead of counting React raw child array entries. A following real non-Button node still causes a separator; outline suppresses it. Native-root replacement and removal dispose owned separators without deleting caller-owned nodes.

SplitButtonGroup queries native button descendants and gives nested split containers nearest ownership, unlike the upstream all-descendant traversal. Removed and unmounted buttons lose stale first/last markers, and subtree insertion/removal is reconciled. No Dropdown, Divider or menu behavior is included.

BaseButton is a private runtime leaf; the button subpath provides only its mapped BaseButtonProps type. Button has elementType and __SemiComponentName__, with no Button.Group or other static child API. Legacy upstream lib/es and lib/cjs subpaths are not Vue public entries.

Loading prevents pointer interaction through fixed upstream CSS while native keyboard and programmatic click remain enabled. Native disabled blocks activation. Browser evidence is Chromium-only, with local cached Chromium differing from CI; screenshots do not establish full pixel parity.

mappings.api: Native button/reset/submit, visual type/theme/size/block/circle/colorful, icon position and padding, loading/disabled precedence and native event identity are mapped through Button → IconButton/private BaseButton. Global defaults and group own-key ordering follow the fixed React defaultProps/clone behavior. Group cooperation uses direct DOM registration; Split tracks native descendants with nested ownership and cleanup, with the exact migration differences recorded in limitations.
mappings.types: ButtonProps and mapped BaseButtonProps use Vue button attributes, native event parameters, scalar text and VaporRenderResult slots. HtmlType/Size/Theme/Type/HorizontalPaddingType are button-subpath types, and each group subpath exports its Props/Slots (ButtonGroup also Theme). Runtime BaseButton stays private. React children/icon node props, arbitrary Group events, static Button.Group and global slot configuration are rejected.
mappings.statics: Button preserves elementType="Button" and __SemiComponentName__="Button". No static Group or SplitButtonGroup exists upstream or in this implementation; framework defaultProps/propTypes metadata is replaced by native typed resolution.
mappings.subpaths: Vue exposes the browser root plus explicit button, button/buttonGroup and button/splitButtonGroup entries and button CSS/SCSS; upstream lib/es and lib/cjs paths remain unsupported.

families.reviewedDecision: The native Vapor Divider browser contract is accepted against the fixed upstream source with explicit rendered-DOM slot classification, stable content outlet and Vue attribute/style differences. Strict source and generated declarations, pure Vapor and separate interop behavior, lifecycle cleanup, themed Chinese documentation and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed local verification and independent implementation review. The component creates no Foundation instance or global configuration defaults; acceptance does not extend to other public families.

limitations: Browser native Vapor ESM only; Node root remains infrastructure-only. No CJS, component SSR or hydration support; fixed Vue RC and JSX compiler peer constraints remain.

React children are replaced by a native default slot. Rendered DOM is classified after mount or mutation without executing the slot to probe it. Empty fragments and comments do not enable text lines; whitespace and numeric zero text remain visible. Text-producing components and adjacent text nodes use the inner-text style.

A stable span owns the horizontal slot: text uses the upstream inner-text class, and element or mixed content uses display:contents. This adds a DOM wrapper for non-string content compared with React. Vertical layout does not mount slot content. Long nowrap content can overflow narrow containers as in the fixed stylesheet.

Vue class and StyleValue plus native HTML attributes supplement className/style. innerHTML and textContent are rejected to preserve slot ownership. No automatic role, aria-orientation, global default registration, prefix prop, Foundation instance or static API is introduced. ConfigProvider direction is inherited through its existing DOM wrapper.

Root exports only the Divider value; DividerProps and native DividerSlots are subpath types. Legacy React lib/es and lib/cjs subpaths are not provided. Chromium screenshots demonstrate tested DOM/CSS and themes, not complete pixel parity.

mappings.api: Fixed layout, align, margin, dashed, className and style are mapped to native Vapor props and a default slot. Numeric margin is px on the layout axis with style taking precedence; explicit undefined restores defaults. Native DOM attributes and events are forwarded without replacing owned children.
mappings.types: DividerProps retains fixed property unions with Vue HTML attributes and StyleValue. ReactNode children becomes a VaporRenderResult default slot; unsafe DOM replacement, invented static/global APIs and root DividerProps are rejected.
mappings.statics: The fixed upstream functional Divider has no public static member or imperative component handle; none is added.
mappings.subpaths: The browser root exposes Divider; the divider subpath exposes default/named Divider and DividerProps/DividerSlots. CSS and Sass use the exact fixed two-file Divider closure.

families.reviewedDecision: The native Vapor Space contract is accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 source and styles. Direction, wrap suppression, alignment, named and numeric two-axis gaps, native slot ownership, dynamic keyed children, type surfaces and CSS/RTL behavior were checked in real browsers. Strict source and emitted declarations, documentation, pure Vapor and separate interop execution, four isolated tarball consumer flows and independent change review support delivery. No Foundation state machine, global Space defaults or additional public component family is implied.

limitations: Browser native Vapor ESM only; Node root remains infrastructure-only. No CJS, component SSR or hydration support. Vue RC9 and vue-jsx RC2 remain exact pins.

React children map to a native default slot. Browser flex items determine gaps for mounted DOM; non-whitespace text makes an anonymous flex item while whitespace-only text and comments do not add an item. No VNode list, child clone, slot probe or wrapper is used.

Upstream Spacing[] accepts extra elements but only indices 0 and 1 set column and row gaps; missing axes do not inherit a preset. Numeric spacing overrides same-axis inline styles while named classes yield to inline styles. Vertical wrap is suppressed.

Vue class and safe native attributes supplement className/style. Unsafe innerHTML/textContent replacement is rejected; role and ARIA are caller-owned. ConfigProvider direction is inherited through DOM/CSS rather than a new Space context setting.

Strict isolated tarball consumers verify precompiled ESM/declarations and pure Vapor/interop separately. An actual independent strict installation of pinned vue-jsx 3.3.0-rc.2 with Vue 3.6.0-rc.9 is rejected by npm peer resolution; this does not establish standalone TSX compilation. Screenshots establish tested DOM/CSS only, not pixel parity. Root exports only Space; Align/Spacing/SpaceProps/SpaceSlots are subpath types.

mappings.api: Fixed vertical, wrap, align, spacing, className and style map to one native Vapor inline-flex root and a default slot. Explicit undefined restores defaults. Named tokens and numeric gaps preserve upstream axis and inline-style precedence; native attributes and Vue class are supplemental.
mappings.types: Align, Spacing and SpaceProps retain fixed unions and Spacing[] array length. ReactNode children become SpaceSlots.default returning VaporRenderResult, with Vue HTMLAttributes and StyleValue. Unsafe DOM replacement and invented Space layout APIs are rejected.
mappings.statics: The fixed upstream Space class exposes no public static child component or imperative handle; none is added.
mappings.subpaths: The browser root exposes the Space value; ./space exposes default/named Space plus Align, Spacing, SpaceProps and SpaceSlots. Fixed Space CSS/SCSS is available standalone and in the aggregate. Legacy React lib/es and lib/cjs paths are not Vue entries.

families.reviewedDecision: Row and Col native Vapor browser contracts are accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 grid source, declarations, Chinese documentation and Foundation styles. Responsive class rules, fixed viewport breakpoints, both gutter axes, alignment, nesting, dynamic slot ownership, RTL and cleanup were tested in Chromium. Source and emitted declarations, documentation, four isolated tarball consumers, pure Vapor and separate interop execution, and independent full-file review support local delivery. No Layout, Skeleton, date picker or further component family is implied.

limitations: Row and Col use browser native Vapor ESM. Node root stays infrastructure-only; CJS, component SSR and hydration are not delivered. Vue RC9 and vue-jsx RC2 remain exact pins, with the independent strict peer installation limitation.

Default slots keep native Vapor ownership and state. Col requires a Row ancestor; no VNode probing, clone, wrapper per child, imperative ref API, global defaults or custom responsive breakpoint protocol is added.

Grid uses the fixed upstream 24-column and 576/768/992/1200/1600px CSS breakpoint boundaries. Row gutter objects choose the largest matched breakpoint per axis. ConfigProvider custom responsiveMap does not change Grid breakpoints; inherited direction affects fixed RTL CSS.

Only positive gutter values generate half-margin and half-padding inline geometry; zero falls through to the fixed style baseline. Caller style may override computed margin/padding. Responsive CSS classes cascade and order is visual only.

Isolated tarball consumers validate precompiled ESM/declarations, pure Vapor and interop separately. Browser evidence is Chromium and screenshots of selected states, not pixel parity or other browsers; independent TSX compiler installation remains constrained by the pinned peer mismatch.

mappings.api: Fixed Row type=flex, align, justify, gutter, prefixCls, className and native attrs map to one Vapor row root. Col span, order, offset, push, pull, xs through xxl, prefixCls and attrs map to one Vapor column root. Default slot replaces React children; own Row context carries reactive gutter to direct or nested columns.
mappings.types: RowProps, ColProps, ColSize, Breakpoint and Gutter map at ./grid with Vue HTMLAttributes and native Vapor slots. Upstream RowContextType and RowState are internal and are not exposed. Number and breakpoint-object gutters, including a two-axis pair, follow fixed source contracts.
mappings.statics: Fixed upstream Row and Col have no public static members or imperative handles; none are added.
mappings.subpaths: Browser root exports named Row and Col; ./grid exports both values and public types. Aggregate styles and ./styles/components/grid CSS/SCSS are available. Node root remains infrastructure-only and legacy React lib/es or lib/cjs paths are not Vue entries.

families.reviewedDecision: The native Vapor Layout and static Header, Footer, Content and Sider browser contract is accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 source, Chinese documentation and Foundation styles. Dynamic Sider registration, explicit hasSider behavior, slots, root tags, breakpoint notifications, RTL and narrow-screen geometry, strict source/emitted declarations, four isolated tarball consumers and nine-family regression passed the complete local verify run (566 Vitest across 86 files, 59 website browser checks and 59 harness E2E). Independent stage-1 and stage-2 review found no unresolved actionable issues. Explicit React-to-Vapor and browser-only limits remain recorded below; acceptance does not extend to other public component families.

mappings.api: Fixed Layout hasSider, tagName, prefixCls, className and style map to a native Vapor root with Header, Footer, Content and Sider static members. Sider breakpoint and onBreakpoint report fixed media matches without automatic collapse. Default slots replace React children; native attributes are forwarded only where the fixed component renders them.
mappings.types: Upstream BasicProps, BasicLayoutProps, SiderProps and ResponsiveMap map to ./layout public types with native Vapor slots and Vue style/class types. Upstream BasicLayoutState and ContextType remain internal; LayoutBreakpoint and slot types are Vue-specific.
mappings.statics: The fixed Layout class exposes Header, Footer, Content and Sider as static subcomponents. Only Layout is a root named value export; there are no independent root Header, Footer, Content or Sider values.
mappings.subpaths: Browser root exports Layout and ./layout exposes default/named Layout plus public types. Fixed React lib/es and lib/cjs deep paths are not Vue entries. Aggregate and standalone Layout CSS/SCSS use the pinned two-source Foundation closure.

limitations: Native Vapor browser ESM only; Node root remains infrastructure-only. CJS, component SSR and hydration are not delivered. Vue RC9 and vue-jsx RC2 pins retain the strict independent TSX compiler peer-installation constraint.

React direct-child Sider type inspection can mark the first render horizontal. Vapor does not probe or clone slots or VNodes; Sider instances register with the nearest Layout after mount. Explicit hasSider=true forces horizontal; false does not override a registered Sider. Multiple Siders have separate identities and nested Layouts have separate registries.

React children become native Vapor slots with fragment, conditional and keyed content. A single bare boolean-and Sider slot has a vue-jsx RC2 unmount limitation; v-if or a fragment is required for a reliable conditional. Dynamic tagName replaces the root and remounts slot children, resetting their state and focus and re-registering Sider; browser movement of focused keyed nodes may also lose focus.

Sider breakpoint reports fixed media matches only; it does not collapse, hide or resize the Sider. The fixed React component subscribes only at mount; this Vapor adaptation resubscribes on breakpoint changes and cleans listeners on unmount. Fixed Sider declares role but does not render it, and forwards only data attributes, aria-label, className and style.

Root exports only Layout; Header, Footer, Content and Sider are static members. React lib/es and lib/cjs paths are not exposed. Chromium screenshots verify selected DOM and CSS states, not complete pixel parity or other browsers.

families.reviewedDecision: The native Vapor Skeleton and five static placeholder subcomponents are accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 source, Chinese documentation and Foundation styles. Loading branch ownership, dynamic slots and props, standalone items, CSS animation, strict source and emitted declarations, live examples, Chromium behavior and three direct Skeleton tarball consumer surfaces plus a fourth Foundation regression flow passed local verification and independent review. React-to-Vapor differences and browser-only limits remain explicit; this decision does not accept independent Avatar, Typography, Image or other public families.

mappings.api: Skeleton loading defaults true, active adds the animation class, placeholder and children become named/default native Vapor slots, and only the loading branch has a semi-skeleton div with x-semi-prop=placeholder. Avatar, Title, Button, Paragraph and Image are static placeholder members. Root class/style/native attributes apply to the loading div, while real content is returned without a wrapper. Standalone item defaults, dynamic rows and CSS geometry follow the fixed source.
mappings.types: SkeletonProps, AvatarProps, ParagraphProps, GenericProps and source item BasicProps map to ./skeleton with Vue HTML attributes and native Vapor slots; SkeletonSlots and SkeletonAvatarSize are explicit Vue types. ReactNode props are rejected, and root only exports the Skeleton value.
mappings.statics: The fixed Skeleton class exposes Avatar, Title, Button, Paragraph and Image static subcomponents. No independent root values for these placeholder pieces are added.
mappings.subpaths: Browser root exports Skeleton; ./skeleton exports default/named Skeleton and public types. Aggregate and standalone CSS/SCSS use the pinned four-source Foundation closure. Fixed React lib/es and lib/cjs deep paths are not Vue entries; Node root remains infrastructure-only.

limitations: Native Vapor browser ESM only; Node root remains infrastructure-only. CJS, component SSR and hydration are not delivered. Vue RC9 and vue-jsx RC2 exact pins retain the strict independent TSX compiler peer-installation constraint.

React placeholder/children nodes become native named/default Vapor slots. The branches are mutually exclusive and remount contents on every loading transition, so local state and focus do not persist across transitions. No slot pre-execution, VNode inspection or cloning is used.

Skeleton without a placeholder slot renders an empty loading div. Root attributes are not forwarded when loading=false; standalone subcomponents use their own DOM roots. Paragraph rows=0 is empty, while negative or fractional array lengths retain the source error boundary.

The source Avatar size set includes default but pinned Skeleton SCSS has no default-size dimension rule. Paragraph forwards native attributes as a Vue extension where React only forwards className/style. Custom prefix/type classes need caller CSS.

Animation is fixed CSS under an active ancestor, with no JS timer, listener or Foundation instance. Theme and RTL inherit from CSS. Screenshots cover selected Chromium states, not complete pixel parity or other browsers.

Fixed React item generator places its default type before caller props, so explicit type=undefined overrides the value and Generic.render throws; the Vapor adaptation restores the built-in kind for undefined and dynamic removal, with a browser assertion.

Skeleton is directly exercised by declaration/runtime, style, and pure/interop resource tarball consumers. The separate patched Foundation tarball flow is a preserved regression gate and does not directly exercise Skeleton.

families.reviewedDecision: Native Vapor Highlight is accepted against the fixed UI, Foundation matching algorithm and Chinese documentation contract. Source and strict declarations, differential and browser behavior, documentation examples, per-file coverage, package provenance and four isolated tarball consumer flows passed and were independently reviewed. Wrapper-free text roots and the explicit script/style tag rejection are documented; no other public family is accepted by this decision.

mappings.api: Seven upstream props; sourceString defaults empty, searchWords defaults empty, autoEscape true, caseSensitive false and component mark. Unmatched substrings are native text nodes, matched chunks use the selected tag with semi-highlight-tag and global/keyword class/style precedence. No wrapper, attrs forwarding, slots, events, expose, statics or ConfigProvider/default registry. Private pure matching follows fixed Foundation UTF-16/regex/adjacent and overlapping interval rules. Native Vue createFor uses chunk.start keys and private Vapor Chunk/Mark components; no vue-jsx runtime For or VDOM code is introduced.
mappings.types: HighlightProps is exported only from ./highlight; keyword objects retain text/className/string-valued style and the upstream declared-but-runtime-invalid undefined member. CSSProperties is Vue-native and React types are not exposed. No new public matcher or Foundation type re-exports.
mappings.statics: Highlight has no public static children, helpers or exposed imperative methods.
mappings.subpaths: Browser root exports only Highlight; ./highlight exports default/named Highlight and HighlightProps. Aggregate and on-demand CSS/SCSS use the two pinned Foundation sources. Node root stays infrastructure-only; no CJS or legacy React deep-path aliases.

limitations: 没有包装根或属性/slot透传；class/style/id/ARIA等放在调用方真实容器，component只选择命中片段标签。
生成命中标签时显式拒绝不区分大小写的script/style并抛TypeError；原生Vapor浏览器实测这两种标签会把文字作为脚本/CSS消费，这是有证据的安全差异。其余component仍是开发者可信原生标签字符串；void标签和自定义元素保持原生行为，不能声称任意标签安全显示文本。
私有纯匹配器最小适配固定Foundation算法，通过真正固定源差分测试；不扩展G06 input/tooltip补丁入口，不引入Foundation/lodash运行时或公开匹配工具。
autoEscape=false仍为同步JavaScript正则，无超时/回溯防护；非法模式SyntaxError。空词忽略，但数组undefined成员按固定上游抛TypeError。索引/regex为UTF-16、无u标志或规范化，非字素匹配。
默认mark语义可由component改变；没有内建焦点/键盘交互/状态播报，方向、换行与溢出由容器CSS决定。
三条真实tarball表面直接验证Highlight，第四Foundation流程是既有回归。纯Vapor与interop分别验证；固定RC peer严格独立TSX编译器安装限制保持，预编译应用不替代该安装验证。
仅浏览器ESM和已测Chromium场景；无组件SSR/水合/CJS或完整像素一致性声明，不接受其他公共或AI组件。

families.reviewedDecision: The fixed Progress browser contract is accepted with explicit native Vapor format-slot, opaque motion typing, lifecycle cancellation, nonfinite-number, token lookup and stable SVG identity differences. Strict source/generated declarations, real browser behavior, Chinese examples, production E2E and four actual tarball consumer stages passed local verification. Complete code and artifact review found no unresolved actionable issue; pure Vapor and ordinary Vue interop remain separate, with the existing TSX peer and SSR/hydration/CJS limits.

mappings.api: Fixed Progress line/circle and indeterminate contract, horizontal/vertical direction, actual sizes and SVG geometry, controlled percentage, threshold/gradient colors, orbit styling, data attributes and captured global defaults. Native format scoped slot owns complex content; scalar format callback is synchronous and display-only. No status, built-in status icons, default content slot, events or imperative expose.
mappings.types: ProgressProps and the explicit Vue-native ProgressSlots/ProgressFormat/ProgressMotion/ProgressStroke are subpath types. React ProgressState describes internal class state and is not a Vue public state API. Motion object/function values only determine truthiness.
mappings.statics: __SemiComponentName__ is Progress metadata; no public child components or imperative methods.
mappings.subpaths: Browser root exports only Progress value. ./progress exports default/named Progress and types; aggregate and on-demand CSS/SCSS use the three pinned Foundation sources. Node root remains infrastructure-only.

limitations: Complex upstream ReactNode formatting maps to an owned native format slot with a readonly percent Ref; it takes precedence over the scalar callback. Content is evaluated only when visible, unlike upstream unconditional format calls. No default slot or raw ReactNode prop is introduced.

NaN percentage normalizes to zero; Infinity/-Infinity render 100/0 and cannot enter nonfinite interpolation. Nonfinite width/strokeWidth use size fallback/4; finite negative or zero geometry retains fixed upstream behavior. Global own undefined percent/strokeWidth/format becomes 0/4/empty, differing from upstream invalid geometry or thrown format call.

Finite extreme width can overflow the circumference to Infinity and remains invalid SVG like the fixed upstream; recovery to ordinary geometry is tested. Opposite extreme percentage interpolation uses weighted terms to avoid upstream subtraction overflow, while parseInt exponential-string frame behavior is retained. No general valid-geometry guarantee is claimed for every finite number.

ProgressMotion is an opaque truthiness migration type: boolean | Record<string, unknown> | ((props: Record<string, unknown>) => Record<string, unknown>). It rejects interface objects or returns without an index signature and narrower callback parameters accepted upstream, while accepting opaque state/onStart values that upstream named fields reject. This is neither full type equivalence nor only stricter typing; no option or callback is consumed, and boolean is recommended.

Private numeric animation uses existing lifecycle scope with guarded RAF and exact cancellation; disabling motion settles and cancels an active animation; replacing a truthy motion reference without changing percent also cancels and settles the target, unlike upstream percent-only update detection. CSS transitions and indeterminate animation remain independent, without automatic reduced-motion handling. The documentation shell independently overrides CSS animation to 1ms/one iteration under reduced motion; isolated component tests retain the fixed 1.2s circle rule. This is host CSS, not automatic component motion handling. No cross-document scheduling isolation is claimed.

The fixed color arithmetic and body-level token lookup are retained, including legacy integer alpha parsing and asymmetric interpolation rounding; parsed array tokens do not watch body theme mutations or resolve from the nearest local theme container and are recalculated on relevant prop updates; sorting copies the array rather than mutating caller input. No new Foundation patch/import allowance or animation dependency.
The outer div and SVG retain identity across size changes; upstream keys the SVG by size. Type/visibility changes may remount formatted content; scoped slot ownership remains with Vue.

Only id, the three explicit accessible naming/text attributes and data attributes are forwarded, plus Vue class alias/root style. role/min/max/now belong to the component; formatted DOM is not automatic accessible text or a live region.

Three tarball surfaces directly verify Progress; patched Foundation is the fourth existing regression flow. Pure Vapor and ordinary Vue interop are separate; independent strict TSX compiler peer rejection is not replaced by precompiled fixtures.
Browser ESM and tested Chromium only; no component SSR/hydration/CJS, full pixel equivalence, other public component or AI product acceptance.

families.reviewedDecision: The public Tooltip browser contract is accepted against fixed Semi Design 2.103.0 with five triggers, sixteen positions, initialization-time defaults, Foundation visibility and geometry, native trigger ownership, primitive callbacks and owned content/arrow slots.
